results.title: Container-based system launches missiles, can be deployed on ships
results.content:
The container’s roof opens before launch, allowing the internal launcher to rise into its firing position. Following launch, the mechanism can retract into the container, preserving the system’s compact configuration for transportation and storage.  
  
Kongsberg has also integrated supporting equipment into the container, including a generator, an electronics compartment, and the mechanisms required to manage launch-related blast effects. Mission planning remains an external function. [...] The test was conducted in Norway, where the missile was launched from a container-based unit holding up to four missiles. The objective was to verify safety aspects, logistical parameters related to handling and loading, as well as the system’s ability to manage pressure and blast effects during launch. [...] The containerized solution represents an alternative way of deploying missile capability. By integrating the launcher into a standard shipping container, the solution can be transported more easily, moved between locations, and incorporated into existing logistics and transportation networks. A launching container can be deployed, without modifications, from ships, trucks or directly from the ground.

results.title: SpaceX launches Starlink satellites from California as Falcon 9 cadence slows (photos) | Space
results.content:
Falcon 9's 100th launch of 2026 was the Starlink 10-49 group from SpaceX's pad at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, which was later revealed to be the final Falcon 9 Starlink mission that would fly from Florida's Space Coast. The same might soon be true for Starlink launches from the West Coast as well. [...] Today's launch was the 116th Falcon 9 flight so far in 2026, with about three-quarters of those being dedicated to Starlink. The reduced cadence will likely solidify 2025 as the Falcon 9's busiest year ever, with 165 launches completed. At its current rate, the Falcon 9 is expected to fly just under 150 missions by the end of this year.
